name: hola-ingeniero
description: ¡Hola Ingeniero! Spanish for the Next Generation of Engineers

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
